tags.children: Metal Forging for Automotive Steering & Powertrain Parts | Varsha Forgings

props.name: description
props.content: Automotive steering and powertrain components from 1 to 25 kg: forging at Aurangabad (since 1989), machining and assembly at Pune (since 2007). EN8, EN19, EN24, EN31, 20MnCr5, SAE 8620, AISI 4140 and AISI 1045 grades; IATF 16949 and ISO 9001:2015 certified.
